summary: The implementation successfully addresses all 7 requirements (REQ-18 through REQ-24). The useFocusMonitor hook tracks page visibility and window focus events with timestamps, calculates distraction scores and switching frequency, includes comprehensive inline comments, and integrates with the backend. A DistractionWarning component displays non-intrusive notifications when thresholds are exceeded. Backend storage for focus scores has been implemented with a recordFocusScore function and migration logic. All acceptance criteria are met.

hallucinated_features.description: Addition of cooldown mechanism in Dashboard.tsx that prevents the distraction warning from reappearing for 5 minutes after dismissal
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-21 specifies dismissible functionality but does not require a cooldown period. The 5-minute cooldown timer logic was not requested in the BuildRequest.

hallucinated_features.description: Implementation of useGetFocusScores query hook in useQueries.ts for fetching focus scores from backend
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-22 specifies sending data to the backend via POST request, but does not require fetching/reading focus scores back from the backend. The GET functionality was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module (backend/migration.mo) implementing data migration logic for upgrading the actor state
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention implementing migration logic or upgrading existing actor state. REQ-23 only requires storing new focus monitoring data in existing backend storage structure.
